camel_example: aliyun ga DescribeCommodity --region cn-hangzhou --OrderType BUY --CommodityCode ga_gapluspre_public_cn --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Queries Global Accelerator commodity information by calling the DescribeCommodity operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeCommodity接口查询全球加速商品信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga describe-commodity --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --commodity-code ga_gapluspre_public_cn --order-type BUY --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCommodity

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The commodity code.

Sample values for Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com):

ga_gapluspre_public_cn: Global Accelerator instance.

ga_plusbwppre_public_cn: basic bandwidth plan.

Sample values for Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com):

ga_pluspre_public_intl: Global Accelerator instance.

ga_bwppreintl_public_intl: basic bandwidth plan
parameters.help_zh:
商品Code。

中国站示例值：

ga_gapluspre_public_cn：全球加速实例。

ga_plusbwppre_public_cn：基础带宽包。

国际站示例值：

ga_pluspre_public_intl：全球加速实例。

ga_bwppreintl_public_intl：基础带宽包
parameters.name: commodity_code

parameters.help_en:
The order type. Valid values:
BUY: new purchase.
RENEW: renewal.
UPGRADE: upgrade
parameters.help_zh:
订单类型。取值：
BUY：新购。
RENEW：续费。
UPGRADE：升级
parameters.name: order_type
